name: Lakshith Portfolio
description: A professional portfolio with project case studies, real repository links, resume integration, and SEO metadata.
summary: A professional presentation of data science, analytics, and development work. Featured case studies connect to repository and demo links, with resume access and search metadata built into the web experience.
architecture: Next.js App Router renders portfolio sections and project case studies. React/TypeScript supply typed reusable components, Tailwind styles responsive layouts, and Framer Motion animates transitions.

capabilities.name: Project case studies
capabilities.description: Present featured work with repository and documented demo links.

capabilities.name: Responsive portfolio
capabilities.description: Provide mobile navigation, resume access, and search metadata.

stack.usage: App Router pages render the portfolio, case studies, sitemap, and metadata.
Reusable components compose professional sections and responsive navigation.
TypeScript defines content contracts for project and portfolio views.
Tailwind provides the portfolio layout and styling utilities.
Framer Motion provides section and interface transitions.

architectureConnections.description: Portfolio routes compose reusable section components.

evidence.notes: Reviewed repository README and available dependency manifests. Capabilities describe implemented workflows; roadmap items are excluded.
